steps.name: Jenna's Song (1)
steps.objective: Talk to [Jenna] in the "Zisk Plains", then defeat the [Aurora Queen] in the "Aurora Garden" and obtain the <Secret Score>. Return to the "Zisk Plains" and report to [Jenna].

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: The wind brushes past us, bidding our tears dry♪

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Goddess of the earth, hold that passing wind♬

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: I know so few songs. I'm tired of singing the same ones over and over...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't mind. You sing so well, Jenna. I love listening.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: You scared me!!

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: %s, how long have you been there? I thought you were a ghost.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: For a moment, I thought I'd misheard that.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Whew. My nerves have settled. Welcome, %s...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I came to see how you were doing.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Thank you for looking out for me...

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Thanks to you, I got to speak with my brother. About little things, and everything that's happened lately... It's all thanks to you, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's nothing. Did Ziskad bring all of this?
(All kinds of food and gift boxes surround Jenna.)

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Yes. Things I used to love. I can't eat them or even touch them, but...

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: I'm happy because I can feel his affection.
(Jenna smiles brightly.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm glad you seem well. But you don't like the songs?

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: I've been singing the same songs for hundreds of years. It's getting tiresome. I'd ask my brother, but he's so busy that I'd feel bad...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait a moment. That gives me an idea...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Would you like me to find some sheet music? I remember someone who had some.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Oh, I'd love that. As long as it isn't too difficult, I can sing from the score!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Getting it won't be a problem, but what if there are several pages? Turning them might be difficult.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Don't worry. I've befriended a few gentle Algae. I'll recruit them to help!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha. That's one way to do it. I'll find the sheet music and come straight back to the estate.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Thank you.

steps.name: Jenna's Song (2)
steps.objective: Defeat [Treacherous Aergia] at the "Lake of Oblivion" and obtain a <Betrayed Spirit's Tear>. Then report to [Iris] inside the "Frozen World" dungeon.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Welcome back.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Here's the sheet music I mentioned. Would you take a look?

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Yes!
(Jenna studies the sheet music intently.)

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Oh, this...

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: I think it's a beautiful serenade!

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: La-la-lee-la, la-la-la♪ La-la-lee-la-la-la-la♪
(Jenna looks delighted.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Is this really the song I heard? The melody's definitely the same as the one the Aurora Queen sang...)

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: The person who sang this must have held someone dear in her heart...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, well...

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Things didn't work out, then? That's a shame. With such a lovely song, I'd have thought they would.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Things don't always turn out the way we hope.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Then let me sing it for you. I've changed the lyrics a little.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right.
(Jenna takes a deep breath and begins humming softly. Her clear, lovely voice spreads across the estate.)

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: My beloved♬

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: The one I've longed to see♬

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Across the years, at last we join hands...♩
(The animals on the estate visibly stop what they are doing and respond to Jenna's voice.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wow... I love the way you sing, Jenna.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Thank you. I really wanted you to hear it. I'll sing it for my brother when he comes, too... Oh, I'd love Lady Gaia and Lady Iris to hear it as well...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm not sure about Gaia, but Iris might be possible. Oh, but you can't leave this place.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Maybe something could help.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: It's a story my mother told me when I was alive. Well... Not exactly when I was alive, I suppose.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Does that still bother you? They're your memories, whatever happened.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: That's true... Thank you for caring.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Anyway! The story was that spirit tears have long been used to hold sounds and emotions.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: I don't know how it works, but the spirits heard me sing, so if they'd just shed a few tears...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: They serve the gods, so it might work somehow. We'd need to find the spirits here...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll collect the tears and take them to Iris. Though technically, it won't be her main body.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I promise. And if I find any good sheet music in the future, I'll bring it to you.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Thank you. Truly... I'll leave it to you.

steps.name: Jenna's Song (3)
steps.objective: Talk to [Iris] in the "Frozen World", then find [Minuet] in "Adrica".

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Welcome, %s...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I saw you recently, Iris, but it feels like ages since I last came to the Frozen World to visit you.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: It does.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Thank you for always believing in me and waiting.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I know you believe in me too. Thank you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll put everything else aside and think about the day this is all over, for your sake.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There are still so many thoughts I haven't sorted out.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Meeting Iris, coming all this way, everything that's happened... And...)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I'll wait.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, are you all right about what happened? What we saw at the estate...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I'm all right. It startled me at first, but I've accepted it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm glad. Oh, I nearly forgot. Jenna asked me for something...
(You briefly explain that you have come at Jenna's request.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Then would you give me the spirit tears?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. Here...
(Holding the spirit tears, Iris reaches toward the sky. The tears rise on the wind, then fall like rain.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Now Jenna's voice will rain down over the Frozen World. We can hear her lovely singing while it falls.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Just as Iris said, Jenna's voice is falling with the rain.)

lines.speaker: 제나의 목소리
lines.text: My beloved♬

lines.speaker: 제나의 목소리
lines.text: The one I've longed to see♬
(Iris closes her eyes and listens to Jenna's voice.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Is Iris crying? Or is that the rain?)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Jenna's voice is wonderful.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll be going now.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Ah, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is it, Iris?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Please let Lady Gaia hear this song too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Can I meet Gaia?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Not exactly Lady Gaia herself, but I think simply speaking to Minuet will do.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, I see. All right, Iris. Thank you.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Take care, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Minuet! Minuet!

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Yes, I'm Minuet! You only need to call once. What brings you...?

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Oh!

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Thank you! What a lovely song!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I haven't said a word yet...

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: As soon as you spoke to me, I could tell.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (So that's what Iris meant.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Jenna, Ziskad's younger sister, wanted Gaia to hear this song.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: So this is what they mean by a treat for the ears.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: You got to hear a song like that in person, %s. I'm jealous...

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: I'd love to hear Jenna sing right in front of me. But I'm bound to Adrica, and she's bound to the Zisk Territory...

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: I suppose it can't be helped.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Though I'd be happy if Lady Gaia could hear her.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Whenever I find new sheet music, I'll take it to Jenna and come visit you the same way I did today.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Oh?
(Minuet's expression seems to change ever so slightly.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's wrong?

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: I'm not sure, but please come here when the time comes. Not right away, but I think you'll need to visit this place.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Lord Atkina and Lady Medea will soon release the seal.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The road to Phobos...)

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Please wait until then.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will. I'm good at waiting.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Then I'll see you later. I think I need a little sleep. Lady Gaia said I should find time to sleep about six hours a day too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Haha. Sleep well, Minuet.
(Minuet falls asleep standing up.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Did she get that from Gaia?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now I'm sleepy too. Maybe I'll go to nearby Tartaros and get some sleep... Yawn...
